source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative path LF sorted; validation outputs and receipt excluded

original_source_lineage.adapted_own_original_provider: native_backing79 private acquisition/validation/ref ownership flow, original host tests and TEST SDK stand-ins, copied under new names; no frozen source changed
original_source_lineage.unchanged_linked_core: private_lifecycle/lifecycle.c and lifecycle.h only; one embedded canonical registry per trusted platform domain
original_source_lineage.not_linked: No old provider79 implementation or control002 implementation in new owner target objects. No upstream driver code copied.

implementation.public_native_surface: native_owned.h includes bounded public values only. Internal owned.h has provider/setup definitions for trusted code and tests, not a lease/view/registry accessor. No callback parameter on public run.
implementation.canonical_join: Actual retained refs are owned by boot-lifetime NativeAnchor. Its one bno_manager owns one c585 registry and exact per-cohort lease. The same lease governs validated backing and effect_begin/result. No second registry or detached native-view export.
implementation.native_unavailable: Fixed module-owned real ops set effect_backend_available=0 and dispatch=null. Shared admission validates token/state/shape/aliases/permissions, then returns BNO_UNAVAILABLE before native query/begin/dispatch and without output/history changes. Tests distinguish invalid/stale/refused state from unavailable.
implementation.host_dispatch: BNO_TEST_DISPATCH enables original ordinary-memory/trace callback in the actual adapter source only with original TEST SDK. TEST-dispatch plus KERNEL is a compile error. Generic C-manager KERNEL-mode tests are host executables with injected trusted fake ops; no target execution.
implementation.input_and_borrow: Bounded value request captured before rechecks/callbacks; no arbitrary address/function pointer in public request. Internal invocation scope carries exact identities/views and canonical ticket, lives only through synchronous dispatch. Trusted module discipline, not isolation against malicious C callbacks. Ops/context copied/retained and code residency is platform obligation.
implementation.order: Short lock/busy -> preflight <=32 effects and four sequence values -> exact three native rechecks -> canonical begin -> scoped dispatch unlocked -> exact result validation -> canonical result. One pending effect, no public begin/result or borrow.
implementation.retention: Any begun effect prevents private zero/copy/complete/ref-reset/retire forever. Failure/unknown/stale-result/changed-view quarantines and halts domain, retaining claims and every still-owned ref/preparation. Nonreturn keeps busy/pending retained; no timeout/free API. Known callback success is not hardware completion.
implementation.finite_limit: 32 lifetime entries per lease; 33rd refuses before query/callback. No erasure, wrap, compaction, token drop or fresh-lease laundering. Sequence preflight reserves three queries plus dispatch. No batch API: only one finite operation per admission. Continuous driver and any multistep workload reservation are not implemented.
implementation.private_retirement: Never-exposed known-private only: all explicit completes successful -> canonical retire -> ref resets. Unknown private reset may already release some refs; reports uncertainty and halts rather than falsely claiming all retained.
implementation.protection_step2: Real pin/configure source is internal and used with test setup inputs only here; no runtime configure call is admitted. New separate protection leaf must bind this receipt/full typed anchor/ops/context, source profile and policy. Frozen002 hardcodes79 and cannot be reused or relabeled. Avoided owner/helper hash cycle.
implementation.physical_policy: Actual 16KiB IOBMD allocation with MapperNone, HostPhysicallyContiguous and maskfffffc000; real PAGE_SIZE/page_size; one explicit prepare pair distinct from constructor baseline; PA36/RAM/reserved/protected/control/cross-job spans checked before zero. Supplied protection completeness remains trusted until new Step2 binding.
implementation.permissions: Public acquire permissions use bit1 READ / bit2 WRITE; reject zero/unknown. DESCRIPTOR/SUBMIT require WRITE and DATA extent1..64B; MAPPING requires READ. Fixed kind/resource unions documented in README; no hardware formats inferred.

host_validation.modes: host and host executable compiled with KERNEL for trusted C coordinator; never XNU execution
host_validation.mutation_rule: Each counted mutant compiled and then failed an assertion. Compile errors and initial harness failures not counted; validation/development-history.json preserves failures.
host_validation.leak_detector: disabled intentionally for retained boot-lifetime anchors and unresolved refs; host test fixtures release ordinary test RAM only between cases
host_validation.ndebug_refusal: Private C, effect C, actual-adapter TEST-SDK tests refuse NDEBUG
host_validation.failure_boundaries: pre/post-application errors, UNKNOWN/malformed/replayed identity fields, changed refs/views, callback reentry and blocked callback lifetime; protected/owned output alias, caller request/table mutation,32-entry and64bit sequence boundaries; private complete/reset order
